title: Settings
description: Your account, its security, the shop's details, its delivery and its team.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear in the admin panel and in the audit log.
profile.name: Full name
profile.saveError: Could not save the profile. Try again.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: The language of the admin panel, and the time zone and format it shows dates, times and numbers in. Automatic follows your browser.

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.description: An admin account cannot be deleted, so the shop never loses the people who run it by accident.
deletion.howTo: To close this account, ask another admin to remove your admin access in Settings › Team. It then becomes a customer account, which you can delete from your account page in the shop.

password.title: Password
password.changeDescription: Change the password you sign in with. You stay signed in here and can sign out your other devices.
password.setDescription: You sign in with Google and have no password yet. Set one to sign in with your email address too, and to turn on two-factor authentication.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: After your password, signing in also asks for a six-digit code from an authenticator app.
twoFactor.requiredNote: Required for every admin in this shop. If you turn it off, the admin panel stays closed until you turn it on again.
twoFactor.needsPassword: Set a password first: turning on two-factor authentication asks for it.

signInMethods.title: Sign-in methods
signInMethods.description: The ways you can sign in to this account.
signInMethods.googleNotice: Signing in with Google does not ask for this shop's six-digit code, so keep two-step verification turned on in your Google account.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices that are signed in to your account right now.

history.title: Sign-in history
history.description: Every successful and failed attempt to sign in to your account, newest first.

sellerDetails.title: Seller details
sellerDetails.description: The business that runs this shop, as shoppers see it in the footer, on the About and product pages, in order emails and on the legal pages. A change here shows everywhere at once.
sellerDetails.legalNameHint: As in the business register (CEIDG or KRS).
sellerDetails.emailHint: Replies to the shop's emails go to this address too.
sellerDetails.conflict: Someone changed the seller details in the meantime. Reload the page to see the change.

validation.postalCodeInvalid: Enter a Polish postal code in the form 00-000.
validation.nipInvalid: This NIP is not valid. Check its 10 digits.
validation.regonInvalid: This REGON is not valid. Check its 9 or 14 digits.
validation.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid number with its country code, e.g. +48 600 000 000.

freeDelivery.label: Free delivery from
freeDelivery.onCaption: Products in the basket, after a discount code

reorder.handle: Drag to reorder, or use arrow keys

methods.restored: {name} restored. Turn it on to offer it again.

form.description: Shoppers see the name in their language and the price at checkout.

sections.carrierDescription: How the parcel reaches the shopper. Both stay fixed once the method is added.
sections.name: Name
sections.nameDescription: Shoppers see the name in their language at checkout.
sections.priceDescription: What delivery costs and whether the checkout offers it.

form.lockerCarrier: Parcel lockers are InPost's, so this method uses InPost.
form.manualShipping: Only InPost parcels are booked from the order page. For this carrier, book the parcel on its site and save the tracking number on the order.
form.statusHint: A hidden method stays out of the checkout without being archived.

archiveDialog.title: Archive {name}?
archiveDialog.description: It disappears from the checkout. Orders already placed with it keep it, and you can restore it later.

errors.DELIVERY_METHOD_LAST_OFFERED: Keep at least one method offered at checkout. To stop selling, pause sales on the dashboard instead.
errors.DELIVERY_METHOD_LOCKER_NEEDS_INPOST: Parcel lockers work only with InPost.
errors.DELIVERY_METHOD_NOT_FOUND: This method no longer exists or was archived. Reload the page.
errors.DELIVERY_METHOD_TYPE_ALREADY_OFFERED: The checkout offers one parcel locker method and one pickup method at a time. Turn the other one off first.
errors.conflict: Someone changed this method in the meantime. Reload the page to see the change.

validation.priceInvalid: Enter a price of 0 or more.

freeDelivery.title: Free delivery
freeDelivery.description: Delivery costs nothing once the products in the basket reach this value, counted after a discount code and before delivery.
freeDelivery.sectionDescription: The checkout tells shoppers how much they have left to spend.
freeDelivery.thresholdHint: The value of the products in the basket, after a discount code and before delivery.

stats.twoFactorRequiredCaption: Panel closed until it is on

admins.title: Admins
admins.ownAccess: Only another admin can change your access.
admins.recentSignInNeeded: To add or remove an admin, sign in again first. Your last sign-in was more than 24 hours ago.

rules.title: How admin access works
rules.description: The rules the shop applies to every change on this page.
rules.verified: Only an account with a confirmed email address can become an admin.
rules.self: Nobody can change their own access, so the shop always keeps at least one admin.
rules.recentSignIn: Adding or removing an admin needs a sign-in from the last 24 hours.
rules.signOut: Removing access signs the person out on every device at once. Their customer account stays.
rules.deletion: An admin account cannot be deleted. Its admin access has to be removed first.
rules.audit: Every change is recorded in the audit log, with who made it.

add.title: Add an admin
add.description: Find the customer account of the person who will help run the shop. They need an account in the shop already.
add.noResults: No customer account matches. The person needs to create an account in the shop and confirm their email address first.
add.unverifiedHint: Only an account with a confirmed email address can become an admin, so the shop's security emails reach the right person. The address is confirmed through the link in the email the shop sent when the account was created.
add.bannedHint: A blocked account cannot become an admin. Unblock it first.
add.confirmDescription: Check what the account will be able to do, then give it access.
add.confirmIntro: The account {email} will be able to:
add.allowsOrders: see and change every order, refund payments and book shipments
add.allowsCatalog: edit products, collections, pages and coupons, and pause sales
add.allowsCustomers: see every customer's details and delete customer accounts
add.allowsSettings: change the shop's settings, and add and remove admins
add.twoFactorRequired: Before the panel opens on this account, two-factor authentication has to be turned on.

remove.title: Remove admin access for {name}?
remove.description: The customer account stays, but it can no longer open this panel and is signed out on every device right away. Access can be given back later.

errors.TEAM_ACCOUNT_BANNED: This account is blocked. Unblock it first.
errors.TEAM_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: This account no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.TEAM_ALREADY_ADMIN: This account is an admin already.
errors.TEAM_EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: This account's email address is not confirmed yet.
errors.TEAM_LAST_ADMIN: That would leave the shop without an admin. Reload the page to see the team as it is now.
errors.TEAM_NOT_ADMIN: This account is no longer an admin. Reload the page.
errors.TEAM_OWN_ACCESS: You cannot change your own admin access.
